item.tib: brnag pa las kyi drwa ba 'chi bdag gshin rje 'khros pa'i rgyud las ma ning nag po'i bzlog mdos mdel kha smrang gi gyer zlog
item.coloph: gshin rje smrang gyer gyis (gyi bzlog) zlog mdel/ nam mkha' snang ba mdog can gyi phyag cha rdzogs so/ phyi rab don du dran pa nam mkhas/ stang dmu tsa gyer med la gdams pa'o//
